context: Two teens debrief after a tense school presentation
purpose: Teach: ひょっと/あふれる/出来れ/なにしろ/ちょっぴり/がっかり/あわて/感触

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふぅ、終わったぁ…だって初めての発表だったし、心臓バクバクだったよ。
lines.en: Phew, it's over... I mean, it was my first presentation, so my heart was pounding.
lines.style: Exhales with visible relief, shoulders dropping after high tension.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お疲れ。ひょっとして途中で言葉に詰まってた?ちょっとあわてて見えたよ。
lines.en: Good work. Were you maybe stuck for words in the middle? You looked a bit flustered.
lines.style: Speaks gently and observantly, half-teasing but genuinely concerned.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、バレてた…質問された瞬間、頭が真っ白で涙があふれるかと思った。
lines.en: Ugh, you noticed... the moment I got the question, my mind went blank and I thought tears would spill out.
lines.style: Voice wobbles slightly, embarrassed laugh covering real emotion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でも先生、最後にうなずいてたじゃん。あれ、結構いい感触だったと思うけど。
lines.en: But the teacher was nodding at the end, right? I thought that was actually a pretty good sign.
lines.style: Reassuring and matter-of-fact, trying to lift her mood with evidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そうかな…自分ではちょっぴり手応えなくて、正直がっかりしてたんだ。
lines.en: You think so... I felt like I didn't quite nail it, and honestly I was a little disappointed.
lines.style: Quiet and self-critical, eyes fixed on the floor between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 気にしすぎだって。なんなら次は一緒に練習しようよ、俺も来週あるしさ。なにしろ人前って慣れだから。
lines.en: You're overthinking it. If you want, let's practice together next time — I've got one next week too. Honestly, speaking in front of people is all about getting used to it.
lines.style: Casual offer with warm undertone, nudging her elbow lightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんと?助かる…リクのアドバイス、いつも役に立つんだよね。出来れば早めにやりたいかも。
lines.en: Really? That helps... your advice is always so useful, you know. If possible, I'd like to do it soon.
lines.style: Brightens visibly, grateful smile breaking through earlier gloom.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やめろって、照れるだろ。とりあえず購買行こう、腹ペコで頭働かない。
lines.en: Cut it out, you're embarrassing me. Anyway let's hit the shop — I'm starving and can't think.
lines.style: Deflects compliment with mock annoyance, already turning to walk.
